recognize_zh: 骨髓切片網狀纖維染色（reticulin）中，黑色纖維明顯增粗、交錯成網並呈平行流線狀，間有小型核分葉少的巨核細胞；代表 CML 伴隨骨髓纖維化。
features: Silver-impregnated reticulin fibers markedly increased in density
Diffuse, intersecting network of fibers with areas of parallel streaming
Scattered megakaryocytes, some small with hypolobated nuclei, entrapped in the fiber network
Hypercellular marrow with no visible fat in this field
Estimated grade MF-2 to MF-3 (no collagen assessment possible on this stain)
describe_en: Reticulin stain of a hypercellular bone marrow biopsy shows a diffuse and dense increase in reticulin fibers forming an extensive intersecting network with focal parallel streaming. Scattered megakaryocytes, including small hypolobated forms, are entrapped within the fibrosis. The fiber density corresponds to at least grade MF-2 by the European consensus scheme; a trichrome stain is needed to assess collagen. In a patient with CML, marrow fibrosis of this degree is an adverse feature that may accompany disease progression.

ddx.vs: PMF has clustered, bulbous 'cloud-like' megakaryocytes and is BCR::ABL1 negative with JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations.

ddx.dx: Acute panmyelosis with myelofibrosis / AML with fibrosis
ddx.vs: These show increased CD34+ blasts on IHC in a fibrotic marrow rather than a chronic-phase maturing granulocytic proliferation.
Carcinoma forms cohesive epithelial clusters that are keratin positive, visible on H&E and IHC.
